% Adapted from the TeX Live circuitikz manual's transformer-core customization example.
\documentclass[border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{circuitikz}
\begin{document}
\begin{circuitikz}
  \draw (0,0) node[transformer core](A){};
  \ctikzset{transformer core/.cd, relative thickness=2, color=red, dash={{4pt}{2pt}}}
  \draw (2,0) node[transformer core](B){};
\end{circuitikz}
\end{document}
